summary: The seven objects 00686380 builds into 00E198AC+58h..+70h are seven leaf classes of the 004F7180 front-end screen hierarchy. Slot +00h of each primary vtable is a 'mov eax, imm32; ret' leaf whose constant is both the 00E18B60 registry index and the 00E08CD8 interface id; the seven ids are 1, 2, 4, 3, 8, 0Ah and 0Bh, and six of the seven are confirmed independently by the layout or data-table names in the class. 005884A0 is not a call into the +58h screen: the shell loads ECX with it and the body ignores it. 005884A0 starts the title music on the manager, writing the +50h handle that docs/FRONTEND_MANAGERS.md left provisional.

screens.notes: Constructor clears 00E194C4..00E194D0 and sets DAT_00E08874 = 1. 00582F30 chains 004F71D0 then calls 00B29E60 (presentation mode) and 00AB6BD0; the layout binding is in the +14h override instead. 00599DB0 and 005905E0 have no Ghidra function defined.
No GUI layout: this is the mission-tree data, not a page. 005CAAF0 reports progress through BSP_LoadingScreen_ReportProgress while it loads.
0062C2C0 has 100 callees and drives FE.scoring_unlock_text, FE.scoring_unlockedunit, award_title_Text, award_detail_Text, debriefing_Clipbox. Not read in full.

Constructor builds a self-linked node at +130h through 0051ACB0 (three self pointers at +0h/+4h/+8h and a byte 1 at +19h). That is the shape of an MSVC std::_Tree head node, but the container was not identified and the reading is provisional. 0051CDE0 builds the objective groups and reads BSP_Game_GetEffectiveGameMode to pick Island_Capture_Group / Competitive_Group / Siege_Group.

Constructor seeds +3Ch/+40h/+44h from the three rdata constants 00CED1DC, 00CE3800 and 00CED1D8. 0052EE30 is one of the six callers of 00A867B0, so it is the screen that opens sound/music/creditsfinal.fsb from manager +48h.
Enter sets FE.main_leaderboards_title. 005629A0 in this class writes main-menu page 0Bh to 00E08874.

Naming mismatch: id 0Bh decodes to INTF_ACHIEVEMENTS (00E08CD8+2Ch = 00CF7604, read directly) but every string in the class says tactical library (FE.taclib_*, FE.unitlib_*). The menu item that reaches it is FE.main_tacticallibrary and both request sites push 0Bh. Unresolved; the id, not the label, is what the code uses. The table also has an unused INTF_UNITLIB at 5 and INTF_MEDALS at 7. Constructor chains 0093CB10 after the base and builds three eh_vector arrays at +318h (8 bytes x 5), +340h (x 3) and +358h (x 13); read only to param_1[0x127].

hierarchy.correction: The hierarchy has ten slots, not eleven. 004F8B50 at 00CEAE7C is the next .rdata item: every derived table in this packet stops after +24h and is followed by string data (00CEFC84, 00CEC970, 00CED228, 00CEE9F4, 00CF1734, 00CF50F4). docs/GAME_FRONTEND_STATES.md omits slot +14h (004F7590), which two of the seven screens override as the layout binder.

selection_dispatch.finding: None of the seven screens pushes onto the game+5D8h state-request deque. Every producer listed in docs/GAME_FRAME_CONTROL.md is in 004D/004E; no site in 0050..0062 appears. A menu selection is a front-end interface request through BSP_FrontEndManager_PushInterfaceRequest (004CC460) on 00E198AC, which writes only the pending record at +20h/+38h and leaves 006840F0 to drive the manager's virtual +10h on the next servicing pass. The state-request deque is reached later, by the shell.
selection_dispatch.quit_path: Item 6 leads to 00588A80 (FE_pc.main_quit_confirm), the confirmation dialog. Request 13h, the quit path in the drain, is enqueued outside these classes.

sites_read.effect: Resolves two values (005806A0 then 005C27E0, then 005806A0 again), writes them into *(00E198AC)+70h at +9Ch and +A0h with the byte at +A4h cleared, writes mode 5 at +94h and selector 63h at +98h, then calls 004CC460(0Bh, 0).

Calls 004CC460(0Bh, 0) FIRST, then writes mode 4 at +94h and selector 63h at +98h. The reversed order lets a servicing pass between the two see the request with the previous mode still in place; reachability not checked. No selection written.

uncertainties: DAT_00E19504, the native string global passed to createStream, is written at 0058BE63/0058BE6F (0058BDF0) and 0059A16B, none of them in this packet. What selects the track name is unresolved; 'title music' rests on the +40h path the stream is constructed from, not on that name.
Page 8 (00580940) and page 9 (0058C010) are named only by their string sets. 00580940 writes two further page values from registers that were not followed.

00597870 writes the page from its first stack parameter; the four campaign pages are attributed by 00598B60's four-way test plus the DLC title strings in the same body. Its call sites were not enumerated.

00599DB0 (the +58h update virtual) and 005905E0 (its +24h slot) have NO Ghidra function defined; 'ghidra proto' reports 'body ?'. Identified from the vtable only; bodies not read. Ghidra functions must be created at both before any name is applied.
Object sizes are taken from docs/FRONTEND_MANAGERS.md's record of the 00686380 allocation sites, not re-read; each is consistent with the highest field its constructor writes.
005098B0 was read only as far as param_1[0x127]; its tail was not paged in.
The secondary vtables at +08h/+0Ch (and +40h, +64h, +68h in the two large screens) are recorded but not decoded.
005885D0's two selection values come from 005806A0 and 005C27E0, neither of which was read.
Whether the reversed order in 005886C0 is observable was not checked.

corrections_offered.correction: 005884A0 does not act on the screen at +58h; ECX is loaded and ignored. The row should say it starts the title music on the manager.

+50h is no longer provisional: 005884A0 writes it with the stream built from the +40h path. +54h is still unwritten in anything read here; 0052EE30, the credits screen's enter virtual, is the matching caller of 00A867B0 for the +48h path.
Ten slots, not eleven. 004F8B50 at 00CEAE7C is the next .rdata item. Slot +14h (004F7590) is missing from that table and is the layout binder in two of the seven screens.

Ids 1..13h all decode and match src/frontend_managers.cpp's kInterfaceNames; that array is correct as written. The gate doc's table can be extended with 01 INTF_MAINMENU, 02 INTF_MISSIONTREE, 03 INTF_BRIEFING, 04 INTF_REWARDS, 08 INTF_CREDITS, 0A INTF_LEADERBOARDS, 0B INTF_ACHIEVEMENTS.
